identity_source_policy.partially_approved_sheet_rule: Never attach the complete sheet as identity input; only the approved component may be used as a secondary comparison aid while actual photos remain attached.

written_clarity_rule: Every approved private model sheet must contain readable construction notes explaining what to preserve and what to avoid. Generic adjectives are not enough; profile-dependent claims remain explicitly pending until source photographs exist.

face_construction.evidence_status: V4 WAS REJECTED AS A WHOLE-SHEET IDENTITY FAILURE AND IS NON-REUSABLE. THE CURATED-V3 ACTUAL PHOTOS REMAIN THE IDENTITY AUTHORITY. THE NEXT ROUTE IS ONE LARGE PORTRAIT AT A TIME WITH CREATOR APPROVAL AFTER EVERY VIEW, FOLLOWED BY DETERMINISTIC SHEET ASSEMBLY.
face_construction.face_envelope: Soft rounded-to-oval adult face with real cheek breadth and fullness, a short-to-medium lower face, softly squared jaw corners, and a rounded—not sharp or V-shaped—chin.
face_construction.forehead_and_hairline: Natural medium-height forehead and softly curved hairline. Preserve irregular real hairline edges and face-framing strands; do not draw a perfect wig-like arc.
face_construction.brows: Dark, medium-thick brows that remain relatively straight through the inner sections with a low soft arch. Preserve their real thickness and spacing; do not thin, raise, laminate, or glamorize them.
face_construction.eyes: Large, dark, expressive round-almond eyes with prominent dark irises. Preserve the photographed spacing, upper-lid fold, lower-lid fullness, and alert warmth; do not enlarge into doll/anime eyes or add glam liner.
face_construction.nose: Natural medium-width nose with a straight bridge, rounded tip, and real nostril width in the available front and three-quarter photos. Side projection remains pending clean neutral 90-degree photographs; never make it tiny, delicate, pinched, narrow, upturned, or sculpted.
face_construction.lips: Compact natural mouth with a thinner upper lip, fuller lower lip, and real asymmetry. Preserve the photographed smile width and contour; do not overfill, widen, sharpen, or add a beauty-ad pout.
face_construction.cheeks: Soft cheek structure is part of recognition. Keep natural fullness and smile compression; do not hollow or contour the cheeks into a fashion-model face.
face_construction.jaw_and_chin: Grounded softly squared jaw corners and rounded chin in the approved front. Never make the jaw extremely narrow, long, childlike, sharply V-shaped, or doll-like. Side projection remains pending clean neutral profile photographs.
face_construction.ears: Ear placement, projection, and bilateral detail remain pending clean neutral profile photographs. Do not invent additional piercing or perfectly symmetrize unobserved detail.
face_construction.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown South Asian skin. Preserve consistent undertone across views; no whitening, orange cast, heavy blush, or sepia shift.
face_construction.distinguishing_asymmetry: Do not auto-symmetrize the face. Record eyebrow, eye, smile, and cheek asymmetries only after the full angle set is available.
likeness_hard_fails: profile geometry inferred from frontal references

hair_construction.core: Long, dense, very dark hair that is predominantly straight and smooth with soft natural bends, layered ends, and face-framing movement.
locks: mostly straight texture with soft bends
avoid: generic princess curls or exaggerated waves

body_construction.build: Natural adult proportions and grounded real-person build; expressive posture without miniaturization or doll-like limbs.
body_construction.posture: Playful warmth and expressive movement, while keeping shoulders, torso, hips, hands, and feet anatomically natural.
